revision_note: Candidate revision 19 by BETA-CONTRACT-SEAL-01 phase B: the 1.0.0 seal of the closed-beta contract. The catalogue is frozen at twenty-seven codes. rate_limited now also names the credential exchange the edge throttles. OPEN-RETENTION stays not_decided and the freeze declares no retention window. No code, identifier or machine changes.

envelope.description: The single externally visible failure shape. Its error_code enum is exactly the key set of this catalog and its retryable value is pinned to the catalog value for the reported code.

rules: message is a stable, caller-safe sentence. It never contains a filesystem path, object key, URL, credential, token, prompt, model payload, SQL, stack trace or personal data.
details carries only the safe_detail_keys declared for the reported code, with scalar values. Opaque identifiers and enum-like classifiers are safe; raw inputs and secrets are not.
correlation_id is always present so an operator can find the full diagnostic record without the response having to carry it.
error_code is stable. Renaming, removing or repurposing a code is a breaking contract change and requires a version change.

An unmapped internal failure maps to internal_error and the original internal code stays in protected diagnostics only; internal_mapping is the complete rule. A code that is not in this catalog is never emitted and never invented at the edge.
The envelope shape does not vary by authorization level; authorization differences are expressed by the code, never by adding or removing fields.
retryable is authoritative. A caller never infers retryability from the HTTP status or the message text.
execution_token, fencing_token and authority_token are forbidden detail keys. Neither the capability value nor any of its legacy names ever appears in an envelope.
detail_value_rules: scalar values only: string, number, boolean or null
at most 256 characters per string value
at most 16 keys per details object

internal_mapping.rule: Every internally typed failure reason is mapped to exactly one code declared in this catalog before it can leave the trust boundary.
rules: An internal analysis stage code, adapter code or worker code that has no declared mapping in this catalog is reported externally as internal_error.
The original internal code is recorded only in protected diagnostics, correlated by correlation_id. It never appears in error_code, message or details and never reaches the external envelope.
An unmapped internal code is never passed through unchanged, never prefixed, never truncated into a new code and never used to invent a catalog entry at the edge.
Giving a recurring internal reason its own stable external code is a deliberate change to this catalog under the versioning policy, not an edge-local or provider-local decision.

categories.validation: The request, payload or declared contract version is not acceptable. Nothing was created or changed.
categories.authorization: The caller is not authenticated, or is authenticated and not permitted for the addressed resource.
categories.not_found: The addressed aggregate does not exist or is not visible to this caller.
categories.state_conflict: The requested transition or command conflicts with durable state, including idempotency-key conflicts.
categories.stale_authority: The caller no longer holds execution or publication authority for the addressed work.
categories.dependency: A required dependency is transiently unavailable, refused the application's own credential, failed to retain bytes the application had staged with it, or a required authoritative reference cannot be resolved.
categories.integrity: Stored or delivered bytes, checksums or manifests do not match their declared identity.
categories.execution: A run, job or attempt terminated in a declared failure state.
categories.policy: An explicit product or operational policy refused the operation.

validation_failed.summary: The request or payload violates a declared schema, enum, format or invariant. Nothing was created or changed.
notes: constraint norms_search_too_broad (W55A-SEAL-01, R-112): the operator's search statement timeout (AUDITMANAGER_NORMS_SEARCH_TIMEOUT_MS) cancelled a searchNorms query. Nothing was created; the caller narrows the query. It is never answered as an empty or partial page.

constraint, portal bundle (W55B-SEAL-01, R-116): uploadDocument accepts one ZIP holding a portal bundle and nothing else; a bare PDF is refused. The registered values, all with field file: portal_bundle_required (the part is not a ZIP, a bare PDF included; the message says how to obtain the bundle), bundle_unreadable (the archive's directory cannot be read), bundle_entry_count (more than eight entries), bundle_directory_entry (a directory entry or a __MACOSX/ entry), bundle_member_name (an absolute, drive-letter, backslash or .. name), bundle_symlink (an entry marked as a symbolic link), bundle_encrypted_member (an encrypted entry), bundle_compression_method (a method other than stored or deflate), bundle_duplicate_member (a name that repeats, also after case folding and NFC), bundle_stem_mismatch (members that do not share one stem), bundle_member_set (a member missing, an unknown member, or one repeated by suffix), bundle_member_size (one member over its size bound, declared or actual; W55B-FIX: a member that unpacks past its own declared size is refused as soon as it does, and _blocks.json is bound at 4 MiB), bundle_total_size (the members' uncompressed bytes over the total bound, declared or actual), bundle_compression_ratio (a member or the archive above the compression-ratio bound), blocks_json_invalid (the portal block list is not valid against the pinned schema), blocks_page_count (its pages do not match the PDF's page count), blocks_count (W55B-FIX: the block list holds more than 100 blocks on one page, more than 3 000 in all, or more than 1 000 IMAGE blocks), results_blocks_mismatch (the recognised-text markdown and the block list disagree about a TEXT or IMAGE block, in either direction) and stamp_audit_invalid (the stamp audit is not JSON or is over its size cap). The PDF member keeps the existing envelope constraints unchanged: pdf_magic_bytes, non_empty (an empty member), parseable_pdf (a structure PDFium cannot parse, or a page whose text it cannot read), not_encrypted, the page-count and byte-size bounds, every_page_has_extractable_text (a page with neither a text layer nor a portal block) and max_bytes (the transport's body cap). The upload's own name answers field source_filename: non_empty (a blank name) and plain_base_name (a name with a separator, a traversal segment or a control character). W55B-FIX adds three for the PDF member, field content, from the reader process the envelope runs it in: pdf_page_content (a page with more than 400 000 drawing elements, path segments and other objects counted into form XObjects, or more than 200 000 characters), pdf_document_content (more than 8 000 000 drawing elements or 20 000 000 characters in all) and pdf_reader_limits (reading the document needed more than the reader's 512 MiB of address space or 60 s). The part name and the member names are never echoed.

W56A-SEAL-01: severity_requires_accept refuses a severity on reject, comment or revoke; canonical_observation_required refuses a decision that names a non-canonical member of a merged finding. Both use safe detail key constraint.

CLASSIFICATION-CORRECTION-01: correctVersionClassification registers these constraints. differs_from_current (field section_code): the requested stage and section equal the current classification. exceeds_current_revision (field expected_revision): the caller names a revision the version does not have yet. minimum (field expected_revision): below 1. type (field expected_revision or reason): not an integer, respectively not text. required (field reason): blank, or without a letter or a digit. max_length (field reason): over 2000 characters after trimming. printable (field reason): a control or surrogate character other than a line break or a tab. enum (field project_stage or section_code): outside the catalogue.

W61-DISPATCHER-01: createAssignment and transitionAssignment refuse an assignee or new assignee that is not an active account holding expert with field assignee_user_uid or new_assignee_user_uid and constraint active_expert_required (the message says whether the account is unknown, archived or without the role; the administrator reads accounts anyway), and a reassignment of assigned or in_progress work to its current assignee with constraint differs_from_current_assignee. A return without a reason is constraint required on field reason; a reason on a start or completion, or a new assignee on anything but a reassignment, is constraint not_allowed.

constraint, price list (W60-PRICE-LIST-01): uploadPriceList refuses the whole file, with field content and aggregate_type PriceList, when it is empty (non_empty), larger than 10 MiB (byte_size <= 10485760), an Excel 97-2003 workbook (price_list_format), an unreadable package or text (price_list_unreadable), text that is neither UTF-8, UTF-16 with a byte-order mark nor Windows-1251 (price_list_encoding), an XLSX part that decompresses past 64 MiB (xlsx_part_size <= 67108864), without a header row naming the name, unit and price columns within its first 20 non-blank rows (price_list_header), with two candidate columns for a required field (price_list_header_ambiguous), with more than 20 000 data rows (data_rows <= 20000) or with no row that reads as a position (price_list_no_positions). A refused file creates no command record, Blob or revision. A row that is not a position is skipped and reported in the revision's parse report, never refused alone. setProjectVendorList refuses entries with mode inherit (field entries, constraint inherit_has_no_entries); a vendor list holds at most 500 entries (field entries, constraint max_items).

constraint, optimisation proposals (W60-OPT-PROPOSALS-01): decideOptimisationProposal refuses a verdict that is not accept, reject or revise (field verdict, constraint enum), a revise without a comment (field comment, constraint required) and a comment over 2000 characters (field comment, constraint max_length). listOptimisationProposals refuses a decision filter that is not pending, accept, reject or revise (field decision, constraint enum). Paging bounds are field offset or limit with the usual range constraints; a malformed identity is constraint pattern.

constraint, executor connections (EXEC-SEAL-01, R-143): the executor operations refuse a revision or a route with field naming the offending property and constraint one of model_not_pinned (pin_id names no model of the provider lock; the same list is returned by listExecutorConnections), field_required_for_kind and field_not_for_kind (a revision lacks a setting its connection kind needs, or carries one that kind does not use), base_url_invalid (not an http or https origin, or it carries a query or a fragment), host_key_invalid (not one public key line), purpose_not_for_kind (a secret purpose the connection kind does not use, or an SSH key for a kind with no SSH endpoint), standby_equals_primary and kind_not_routable (a route names the same connection twice, or a connection whose kind does not serve the work kind). A secret value is never echoed in a refusal, and no detail names one.

constraint, pull channel (EXEC-PULL-01, R-143): issueRunnerToken refuses a lifetime outside 1 to 365 days (field expires_in_days, constraint range) and a connection that is not a pull connection (field kind, constraint kind_not_pull). submitExecutorTaskAnswer refuses an answer that is not the bare JSON document the task's output schema describes with field output_text and constraint output_schema; the message names the first violated location and keyword, never the text, and the claim is kept so the runner may correct and submit again. claimExecutorTask refuses wait_seconds outside 0 to 25 (field wait_seconds, constraint maximum or minimum).

not_found.summary: The addressed aggregate does not exist or is not visible to this caller. The response never reveals the existence of a resource the caller may not see.

authentication_required.summary: No valid authenticated subject was presented. The response carries no hint about the addressed resource.

permission_denied.summary: The authenticated subject is not permitted to perform this operation on this resource. Authorization is decided server-side.
notes: W61-DISPATCHER-01: required_capability assignment:assignee refuses the assignee's moves on an assignment (started, completed, returned) to a caller who may read it but is not its current assignee -- an administrator. role:admin refuses createAssignment and the reassigned and cancelled moves to a non-administrator; role:expert refuses an assignee who no longer holds expert. aggregate_type is WorkAssignment.

conflict.summary: A concurrent write lost the optimistic-concurrency check or a uniqueness invariant would be violated. Used only when no more specific conflict code applies.
notes: conflict_reason (W49-SEAL-01, R-55/R-61) classifies the account and registration conflicts: login_taken (an active account holds the login), request_pending (a registration request for the login is already pending), queue_full (the pending registration queue is at its cap), account_referenced (a purge was refused because something references the account) and last_admin (the change would leave no active account holding admin). It is an enum-like classifier and never raw input; the values are the closed set above, and a refusal of an act on oneself is permission_denied with no detail, not a conflict. That login_taken and request_pending tell a submitter that a login is known is an accepted, registered limitation (W49-PLAN.md section 3.3).

conflict_reason stale_current_snapshot (W55A-SEAL-01, R-113): setCurrentNormSnapshot named an expected_current that is no longer the current norms snapshot, so the designation was not changed. Re-read the snapshot list and decide again; an already-current target is a replay, not a conflict.

conflict_reason version_already_classified (W59-SECTION-SEAL-01): classifyDocumentVersion named a project stage or section that differs from the classification the version already holds. The classification stands and nothing was changed; an exact repeat of the current values is answered with the stored row instead. Changing it is the append-only correction, correctVersionClassification (CLASSIFICATION-CORRECTION-01).

conflict_reason, classification correction (CLASSIFICATION-CORRECTION-01): correctVersionClassification. classification_revision_stale: expected_revision is behind the version's current revision and the request is not an exact repeat (the same expert, stage, section and reason) of the revision after it, so the first correction stands and nothing was changed; a second expert who lost the race lands here even when they asked for the same values. version_not_classified: the version has no confirmed classification yet, so there is nothing to correct; classify it first. An exact repeat is answered with the stored revision, not a conflict. aggregate_type is DocumentVersionClassification.

conflict_reason, decision carryover (W59-DECISION-CARRYOVER-01, R-60): carryOverDecision carried nothing. carryover_pair_not_proposed: the comparison, recomputed with the request's versions, mode and runs when the confirmation arrived, does not propose exactly the named source and target findings as unchanged (the comparison is refused, its findings are over the limit, a newer published run no longer proposes the pair, or the pair is crossed, swapped, foreign or one-sided such as probably_fixed). carryover_source_decision_not_current: the source finding's current verdict is not the accepted or rejected decision the expert was shown (it was superseded, re-given or never existed). carryover_target_already_decided: the target finding already has a decision event other than this exact carryover, including a comment or an earlier carryover. carryover_severity_not_carryable: the source accept carries a severity that the target's observation cannot hold; the severity is never dropped. An exact repeat is answered with the event already carried (replayed), not a conflict. aggregate_type is ExpertDecision.

conflict_reason assignment_open (W61-DISPATCHER-01): createAssignment named a project, or a project and document, that already has an open assignment (assigned, in_progress or returned) with a different assignee or note. Nothing was created; an exact repeat answers the open assignment instead, and the remedy is to reassign or cancel that one. aggregate_type is WorkAssignment.

conflict_reason vendor_list_changed (W60-PRICE-LIST-01): setGlobalVendorList or setProjectVendorList named an expected_vendor_list_id (null meaning that no revision existed) that is no longer the latest revision of that scope and section, so nothing was written. Re-read the vendor lists and apply the change again; an exact repeat of the latest revision writes nothing and is not a conflict.

conflict_reason, optimisation pass (W60-OPT-PROPOSALS-01): startOptimisationPass could not start a pass for the named document set, and nothing was written, not even the Idempotency-Key. The reason names the first unmet precondition, in this order: version_unclassified (the set's current version has no expert-confirmed classification), section_not_ar (it is confirmed as another section), price_list_missing (the project has no price list), analysis_missing (the version has no published run), text_unavailable (the newest published run has no saved text layer), specification_too_large (the version's specification has more than 10 000 rows) and vendor_list_missing (neither the project nor the administrator keeps an AR vendor list). aggregate_type is OptimisationPass.

conflict_reason, executor connections (EXEC-SEAL-01, R-143): connection_archived (the connection is archived, so it takes no revision, secret, probe or route), connection_routed (archiveExecutorConnection on a connection a route still names as primary or standby; the route is changed first) and no_revision (a secret, SSH key, probe or route needs a revision and the connection has none). Nothing was written, not even the Idempotency-Key.

conflict_reason, pull channel (EXEC-PULL-01, R-143): token_shown_once (issueRunnerToken repeated under a key that was already answered: the token's value is stored only as a hash and cannot be shown again; revoke the token and issue another), connection_archived (issueRunnerToken on an archived connection). For a runner: claim_lost (the task is not claimed by this token any more: its lease lapsed and it returned to open or another claim took it, or it was never this token's), task_expired (the task's deadline has passed), task_terminal (the task is answered, failed or cancelled) and answer_differs (a different answer was already accepted for the task). Nothing was written.

state_transition_not_allowed.summary: The requested transition is not declared in state-machines.json for the aggregate's current state. This is the fail-closed answer for every undeclared transition, including any attempt to reopen a terminal aggregate, overwrite a published version or delete a decision event.

idempotency_key_reuse.summary: The idempotency key was already used with a different payload fingerprint. Nothing was created or changed and no duplicate aggregate exists.

idempotency_key_in_progress.summary: A command with the same key and the same payload fingerprint is still executing. The caller retries the same request and never re-issues the command under a new key.

idempotency_key_stale.summary: The command record for this key is no longer available or its outcome could not be established, so the recorded outcome cannot be replayed. The request fails closed instead of re-executing on a guess.
notes: The retention window that makes a command record unavailable is the unresolved OPEN-RETENTION owner decision; no window value is declared here.

unsupported_contract_version.summary: The declared contract or schema version is unknown to this provider. There is no tolerant fallback and no best-effort interpretation.

storage_integrity_error.summary: A declared checksum, byte size or media type does not match the stored or delivered bytes, or a required manifest role is missing. The artifact is never published.

dependency_unavailable.summary: A required adapter such as the metadata store, blob storage, a model provider or the worker transport is transiently unavailable. The operation created nothing and may be retried.
notes: The dependency detail carries a stable dependency class name only, never a host, URL, credential or vendor endpoint.

dependency upload_capacity (W55B-SEAL-01, R-116): two uploads are already in flight in this API process, so a third is refused before its body is read. Nothing was created; the response carries a Retry-After header and the caller sends the same upload again later. It names a stable dependency class only, never a count or a host.

dependency, executor connections (EXEC-SEAL-01, R-143): secrets_public_key_missing (setExecutorSecret or generateExecutorSshKey on an API process that holds no public key of the secrets ring; the value is never stored in the clear and nothing was written). The worker-side stable class names secret_unreadable (a secret whose key id is missing from the worker's ring, or whose destination differs from the revision about to be called), executor_route_missing and no_executor_online belong to EXEC-HTTP-01.

dependency, pull channel (EXEC-PULL-01, R-143): no_executor_online (a pull task was never claimed before its deadline: no runner took it, so no model ran; dispatch class not_sent, retry_safe false), executor_deadline (a runner claimed the task and did not answer before the deadline, or the attempt had too little time left to wait; for a claimed task the dispatch class is outcome_unknown) and executor_task_failed (a runner reported that it could not answer after claiming; outcome_unknown).

dependency_credential_refused.summary: A required dependency refused the application's own credential. This is a server-side configuration fault with no authenticated subject of this API involved: nothing was created, and retrying does not change the outcome until an operator repairs the credential.
notes: Distinct from permission_denied, which is about an authenticated subject's rights over the addressed resource. This code carries no subject and no capability, because there is no subject in the scenario: the caller did nothing wrong and can do nothing about it.
Distinct from dependency_unavailable, which is transient and retryable. The dependency answered, promptly and correctly, and refused us. Retrying repeats the refusal.

The status is 5xx because the fault is the server's. A 4xx would attribute a rejected application credential to the caller, which is the confusion D-7 records; giving the case its own code but leaving it on 403 would settle only half of it.

The dependency detail carries a stable dependency class name only, never a host, URL, credential, bucket or vendor endpoint. It is the vocabulary dependency_unavailable already uses, so the pair is read the same way.

safe_detail_keys is deliberately just that one key. aggregate_type and required_capability are not carried: they describe a subject's rights over the addressed aggregate, they are exactly what made the two 403s indistinguishable, and the addressed aggregate is not what failed. The environment variable at fault is not carried either; the catalog's own safety rule puts operator diagnostics behind correlation_id.

staged_upload_lost.summary: The blob store no longer holds the bytes this upload staged with it, so the upload cannot be completed. Nothing was published and nothing was changed; sending the same upload again is the remedy.
notes: Distinct from conflict, which this reported until R-8 alongside the opposite situation. Nothing here conflicts with durable state: no blob was published under these bytes and no uniqueness invariant was violated. The store simply did not keep what it had accepted. The other conflict with aggregate_type Blob means the addressed bytes are already published under different declared attributes, which an operator answers by stopping, not by retrying.

retryable is true, and it is the whole reason this is a code and not a wider safe_detail_keys on conflict. conflict pins retryable false, which is right for an immutable blob already published and wrong here. A detail key cannot carry a different retryable, because the envelope reads that flag from this catalog for the reported code and from nowhere else; only a separate code carries a separate value. That is the argument the owner accepted in R-8 when a widened key set was offered instead: widening the keys would have left half the defect standing.

The status is 503 rather than 409 because nothing conflicted, and rather than 500 because the request is worth repeating unchanged. It is the status dependency_unavailable already carries for the case a caller answers by sending the same request again, so the pair is read the same way.

safe_detail_keys is deliberately just dependency, the stable dependency class name, never a host, URL, bucket or object key. blob_id is not carried because no blob exists: these bytes were never published and were never addressable. role and media_type are not carried either -- they are the caller's own declaration handed back, and they say nothing about what failed.

required_norm_unavailable.summary: An authoritative reference the run depends on, such as the NormsSnapshot, PromptBundle or AnalysisProfile, cannot be resolved to an immutable versioned record. No unversioned, partial or substitute norm source is used instead.
notes: reference_kind (W55A-SEAL-01, R-112, R-113, CD-19) names which authoritative reference could not be resolved. Values registered for the norms operations: norms_snapshot (no norms snapshot is current, or an explicitly named snapshot has never been current, so text search has nothing it may read; W57 uses the same value when a run that reads norms finds no usable snapshot), norm_embedding_build (a snapshot named for designation as current has no complete bge-m3-dense-v1 build over its reliability-aware chunks) and norm_source (a snapshot named for designation, or a norm document whose PDF is requested, lacks a confirmed custody binding of the source PDF). W57 adds norm_retrieval_set. It is an enum-like classifier and never raw input; norms_snapshot_id may accompany it.

reference_kind analysis_profile (W59-SECTION-SEAL-01; BETA-CONTRACT-SEAL-01 keeps it for one case only): the run's pinned analysis_profile_id and prompt_bundle_id pair is not registered in this deployment. The executor refuses it before any stage runs, with both identities in the details, and no other profile is substituted. The two refusals of run routing, which precede the idempotency key's claim and write nothing, are not this code since BETA-CONTRACT-SEAL-01 (D-179): startRun and reauditRun answer version_classification_required for a version with no expert-confirmed stage and section and section_profile_unavailable for a confirmed section with no registered text profile. An old client that read required_norm_unavailable with reference_kind version_classification or analysis_profile for those two cases reads the new codes instead; the contract was a draft.

version_classification_required.summary: A run or re-audit cannot start because the version has no expert-confirmed project stage and section, or its stored pair is not internally consistent, so no analysis profile can be selected. The profile is never guessed and the AR profile is never substituted.
notes: Answered by startRun and reauditRun after the version is read and before the Idempotency-Key is claimed, so nothing is written: no command record, run, job or event. An expert confirms the version's stage and section with classifyDocumentVersion; the same request can then be sent. retryable is false because repeating the request unchanged is refused again until the classification exists. BETA-CONTRACT-SEAL-01 gives this refusal its own code (D-179); a draft of this contract reported it as required_norm_unavailable with reference_kind version_classification.

section_profile_unavailable.summary: A run or re-audit cannot start because the version's expert-confirmed section has no registered executable text profile. No other section's profile is substituted.
notes: Answered by startRun and reauditRun after the version is read and before the Idempotency-Key is claimed, so nothing is written. The section is a confirmed one (a section with no profile package, such as PB, or a package the registry refused); the request is refused again until a profile for it is registered in the deployment. retryable is false for that reason. BETA-CONTRACT-SEAL-01 gives this refusal its own code (D-179); a draft of this contract reported it as required_norm_unavailable with reference_kind analysis_profile and no analysis_profile_id. A pinned pair that a deployment no longer registers, found when the executor loads a run's profile, stays required_norm_unavailable with reference_kind analysis_profile.

analysis_input_invalid.summary: A delivered analysis package or a declared stage input is not acceptable. Stage-specific field semantics belong to the analysis contract family; this code is the externally visible mapping.

analysis_failed.summary: The analysis execution terminated in the failed terminal state. The failure is recorded on the run and no partial output is published as if it were complete.

partial_result_not_publishable.summary: The addressed run terminated as partial and the requested operation requires a complete run. The partial outcome and its missing set stay visible instead of being silently completed or silently degraded.

cost_budget_exceeded.summary: The declared cost or token budget for the run or subject is exhausted. Execution stops explicitly instead of silently degrading quality.

analysis_input_budget_exceeded.summary: The document version's text is larger than the analysis input budget derived from the configured model and the per-run cost ceiling. The run was refused up front: no run exists and nothing was sent to a model.
notes: Answered by startRun and reauditRun, before the run is created, when the version's recorded text_character_count (pypdfium2's count over the whole document) exceeds the budget. character_count is that count and budget_characters is the budget in force now; both are integers. A re-audit runs on the current configuration (R-82), so it faces today's budget, not the source run's. A version with no recorded count (published before the portal-bundle upload) is not refused by this rule. The budget is an operator setting derived at start-up from the configured model and the cost ceiling; changing either changes the answer for the same version, which is why this is a refusal and not a property of the document.

It is answered before any run or job exists, so no row carries it. Migration 0022 widens the four stored-error CHECKs for model_identity_mismatch; this pre-run refusal and the edge-only rate_limited code remain outside their stored vocabulary.

model_identity_mismatch.summary: The model named by the provider response does not match the configured and pinned model. The stage fails closed and publishes no finding.
notes: Never echo the provider model name, response body, endpoint or credential in the caller-safe message or details. No live model is selected by this contract seal.

Pull channel (EXEC-PULL-01): submitExecutorTaskAnswer answers a declared model that is not the one the connection pins with this code and HTTP status 422, not the catalog's 502. The caller declared the model, so the request is refused (a runner treats 5xx as transient and would retry); the claim is kept. The declared model is never echoed. The worker applies the same R-133 comparison again to the model the answer carries, and records the call with identity_basis declared.

stale_attempt.summary: The submitting Attempt is not the current publication authority for its Job because it is superseded, lost, cancelled or failed. The delivered result is stored as immutable evidence and is never applied to project state.

execution_token_invalid.summary: The presented execution authority capability is absent, malformed or not the current one for this Job. The token value itself is never echoed back in the envelope.
notes: The capability is named execution_token. fencing_token and authority_token are legacy evidence names and are forbidden detail keys, so neither the value nor a legacy field name can appear in the envelope.

rate_limited.summary: Too many requests of this kind arrived from this client within the throttle window. Nothing was created or changed; the same request may be sent again later.
notes: Answered only by the edge in front of /api/v1 (the proxy's limit_req on POST /registrations and POST /registrations/status, W49-EDGE-01, and, since HARDEN-AUTH-EDGE-01, on POST /auth/token, the credential exchange: its own zone, six a minute per client address with a burst of ten). The application itself never raises it and no column stores it, which is why the database's code vocabulary is the catalog minus this code.

The throttle is per client address and says nothing about any account or request, so the refusal carries no detail key: a key naming what was throttled would tell a stranger which login is under attack, whether the throttled call is a registration or the credential exchange.
retryable is true because the same request succeeds once the window has passed; the status is 429 because the refusal is a rate, not a conflict with durable state.

internal_error.summary: An unclassified server fault. The envelope still carries a stable code and correlation id; no internal path, payload, query or stack trace is exposed.
notes: internal_mapping declares what happens to an internal code this catalog does not declare: it is reported as internal_error and the original code stays in protected diagnostics. That rule resolves OQ-06.

open_owner_decisions.statement: This catalog deliberately declares no code for deleting or overwriting an expert decision event. Under the approved append-only semantics such a request is an undeclared transition and fails with state_transition_not_allowed. The delete and overwrite behavior recorded in EX-02 is not adopted and needs no code.
open_owner_decisions.modification: Revocation moves the current projection for the affected finding to pending. The projection never restores an earlier superseded verdict automatically; a verdict after a revocation exists only where an authorized expert appended a new decision event. This modification also resolves OQ-03. Revocation stays a normal appended event, so the modification adds no new error code and none is added here.

open_owner_decisions.statement: stale_attempt and execution_token_invalid rest on AuditRun, Job and Attempt being distinct entities with mandatory current-attempt authority. DW-03 and DW-05 record that legacy has attempt tokens and connection epochs but no canonical fencing contract.
open_owner_decisions.modification: The AuditRun creation rule is fixed. A new AuditRun is created when a top-level audit or re-audit command is accepted for a frozen set of inputs and configurations. A repeat with the same idempotency key and the same payload returns the existing Run. Changed inputs, an explicit re-audit, or a repeat of a terminal Run create a new Run. Retry, resume, restart and worker failover create no Run and no Job: the Job stays the same and a new Attempt is created. A terminal Run is never reopened. The rule adds no new code: an idempotent repeat replays the recorded outcome, a same-key different-payload repeat is idempotency_key_reuse, and any request that would reopen a terminal run is state_transition_not_allowed.

open_owner_decisions.statement: idempotency_key_stale names the fail-closed outcome once a command record is unavailable. The retention window, legal-hold and tenant or identity-provider semantics that would decide when that happens are not declared by this contract.
open_owner_decisions.gate: Owner input U-04 (tenant model, identity provider, retention TTL matrix, legal-hold authority) recorded in docs/architecture/CP00_ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW.md section 11. It keeps ADR-0014 in proposed status. No numeric retention, TTL or legal-hold value may be declared by any lane before that input exists. At the 1.0.0 freeze (BETA-CONTRACT-SEAL-01) this stays not_decided: the contract declares no retention window, TTL or legal-hold rule, and idempotency_key_stale names the fail-closed outcome without saying after how long it happens. Deciding one later is a compatible addition under VERSIONING_AND_FREEZE_POLICY.md (criterion B11 is deferred by R-141c).

resolved_questions.question: Which externally visible code does an internal analysis stage error map to when the stage code is not in this catalog?
resolved_questions.resolution: internal_error. The original internal code stays in protected diagnostics correlated by correlation_id and never reaches the external envelope; internal_mapping carries the full rule.
